Preview notes

Considered design.
Clear sources.

This is an unofficial redesign concept. It does not reserve places, send form submissions or take payments. Information was checked on 11 October 2026.

What has been corrected

Three-subject weekly fee: €55 from the dedicated 2026/27 fees page ↗, replacing the €50 homepage promotion. The owner must resolve the source discrepancy before launch.
Easter course: 30 March–3 April 2027 from the dedicated course page ↗, replacing the 2026 About-page promotion.
Privacy wording: the original 40-day access-response statement is replaced with current DPC guidance. See the preview privacy notice for details and the launch-policy requirements.

Dates and claims handled carefully

The 5 September 2026 open day and September class restart dates have passed; they are not presented as upcoming events. The homepage’s anniversary statement is replaced with the 2002 founding date reported in Caitriona’s public professional profile.

Teacher credentials are attributed to the existing website rather than independently certified here. No class-size number, results statistic, star rating or guarantee has been added. The parent-review excerpt is attributed and dated.

A timetable with real constraints

The planner contains 40 published weekly sessions: 23 Leaving Cert and 17 Junior Cycle. It selects one class for each of up to three different subjects, flags overlapping times and uses the dedicated weekly fees. It does not imply availability.

Subjects listed by the business without a weekly slot remain in the subject directory, with an instruction to ask for times. Oral course dates remain “to be announced”. Easter time blocks are transcribed without invented subject dates.

Photography and identity

The existing site contains promotional graphics and older imagery whose authorship, permissions and connection to the current teaching team could not be verified. None is presented as authentic team or classroom photography. This concept uses typography, a proposed book mark and Solomon’s actual timetable. The red accent retains the direction of the existing red wordmark.

What needs the owner’s approval

Current prices, enrolment availability, any semester discount, course conditions, hybrid subject coverage, teacher biographies and credentials, brand use, photography permissions, safeguarding and the complete live-site legal policies. Connect an authorised enquiry service and agree who monitors it before activating form submission.
